response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with a strong craftsmanship mindset and even some IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI), but the core stack does not match. His career centers on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, with only minor Java exposure, no Kotlin, and no evidence of Spring or JVM ecosystem depth — all hard requirements for this role. The gap on the primary technical qualifications is too large for a senior JVM tooling position.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience on NI LabWindows/CVI (C IDE for engineers)
Broad, senior-level engineering background with systems, performance, and low-latency work
Strong testing/tooling interest shown through open-source test frameworks and workshops
concerns: No demonstrable Kotlin experience and only marginal, dated Java experience
No Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, or enterprise JVM framework background
Recent work is web/full-stack (TypeScript/Node.js), far from JVM internals and language tooling

key_factors.factor: No JVM internals or language-tooling track record
